target_audience: News editors, journalists, editorial workflow managers, content reviewers

core_principles: Tactical Density: Maximize information clarity and rapid triage without visual noise
Editorial Precision: Distinct visual contrast between raw feeds (original) and polished output (rewritten)
Unmistakable Status Hierarchy: Color-coded workflow pills with high APCA contrast and immediate accessibility
Side-by-Side Clarity: Side-by-side comparative split pane for raw vs rewritten title & content editing
Zero Visual Slop: Sharp 1px borders, subtle slate backgrounds, dark/light toggle readiness, no generic centered layouts

scale.h1_page_header: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-50
scale.h2_section_header: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100
scale.eyebrow_label: text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono

action_buttons.primary_approve: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-medium shadow-sm transition-colors
action_buttons.primary_publish: bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white font-medium shadow-sm transition-colors
action_buttons.secondary_rewrite: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-medium shadow-sm transition-colors
action_buttons.neutral_action: bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 shadow-sm transition-colors

grids_and_layouts.tab_navigation_bar: flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2 border-b border-slate-800 mb-6

stat_cards.description: Top metric cards displaying count per status with filter triggers
stat_cards.style: p-5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm

status_tabs.description: Top bar navigation for switching between Pending_Review, Approved_For_Rewrite, Rewritten_Pending_Publish, Published, and All Items
status_tabs.style: px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg transition-all

news_item_card.description: Card previewing single news item with media thumbnail, original vs rewritten titles, source link, and workflow actions
news_item_card.style: rounded-xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800/80 hover:border-slate-700 p-5 space-y-4 shadow-md transition-all flex flex-col justify-between

side_by_side_modal_editor.description: Detailed inspection and editing modal showing Original Feed on left and Rewritten Article Draft on right with real-time word counts and media player
side_by_side_modal_editor.style: max-w-6xl w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden

media_preview.description: Supports photo thumbnail preview and video player preview with full screen lightbox toggle
media_preview.photo_style: aspect-video rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-slate-800 object-cover w-full
media_preview.video_style: aspect-video rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-slate-800 w-full bg-slate-950

motion_and_interactions.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for approval, publish, and rewrite save confirmations

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='tab-pending-review', data-testid='action-approve-btn', data-testid='side-by-side-modal')
Build the dashboard with tabbed views for the 4 explicit statuses: Pending_Review, Approved_For_Rewrite, Rewritten_Pending_Publish, Published
Implement the side-by-side comparative editor view (Original Feed on Left vs Rewritten Article on Right) inside a modal or split pane
Provide quick-action buttons directly on cards (Approve, Submit Rewrite, Publish, Edit) matching status transition rules
Support media handling with clear distinction between photo and video previews
Use lucide-react or @heroicons/react for clear editorial and workflow state icons
Integrate Sonner toasts for instant feedback on status updates and database syncs

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure high APCA contrast ratios, explicit keyboard focus rings, and clear state labels
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not use 'transition: all' globally; apply specific transitions on background-color, border-color, and opacity
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous interior container padding (p-5 to p-8) to avoid text-to-border collisions
